festival_ablation.conclusion: Festival features did not help on test (Test MAE worsened 3.37->3.86, +14.5%; Val MAE 3.02->3.02). Excluded from serving model.

selection_criterion: Lowest chronological validation MAE (never test MAE)
simulator_diagnostic_note: Root cause of prior 11-12 MAE fixed: 3-second scheduler ticks had been mixed with 1h seeded history; resampling readings to strict 1h buckets before 70/15/15 windowing restores consistent 72h->24h sequences.
simulator_coverage_note: Trained & evaluated chronologically on simulated reference tower MUM-C101 (4,440 1h-resampled hours) and served as a shared simulator model across all 99 simulated NOC towers (never trained on OpenCellID cells).
